meta_description:
1,641 likes, 38 comments - beebomco on October 9, 2026: "5 Best Snapdragon-Powered Laptops To Buy This Festive Season

Deal Details:

Lenovo Yoga Slim 7X with the latest Snapdragon X2 Plus - Just 89,990* (Croma)

HP Omnibook 3 (X) - Starts 46,990* (Flipkart)

ASUS Vivobook 14 (X) - Just 50,990* (Flipkart)

ASUS Vivobook S14 Flip (X)- Just 89,990* (Flipkart)

Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 (X) - 56,990* (Flipkart)

If you’re getting a laptop this festive season, Snapdragon X Series laptops are worth considering. Snapdragon X brings multi-day battery life, class-leading CPU and NPU performance, and a design made for powerful everyday computing on Windows.

The Lenovo Yoga Slim 7x comes with the latest Snapdragon X2 Plus. It has an OLED display in a 13.9mm slim body, and its 80 TOPS NPU handles AI work on the device itself. It is available for ₹89,990 during the sale.

The ASUS Vivobook 14 is a good option for students. It is powered by Snapdragon X and comes with 16GB RAM, which handles classes and multiple browser tabs. It has a solid build and more than 25 hours of battery life. During the sale, it is available for ₹50,990.

The ASUS Vivobook S14 Flip is a 2-in-1 laptop with a 14-inch OLED touchscreen and an all-metal body. The display flips around for movies or tablet-style use, and the laptop supports a stylus. It is powered by Snapdragon X and offers up to 25 hours of battery life. It is available for ₹89,990 during the sale.

The HP OmniBook 3 is a slim and light laptop powered by Snapdragon X. It ships with a compact GaN charger, and HP claims up to 36 hours of battery life. It is available for ₹46,990 during the sale.

The Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 is the pick for those who want a larger display. It has a 15.3-inch screen, Snapdragon X, 16GB RAM and a 512GB SSD, along with more than 20 hours of battery life. It is available for ₹56,990 during the sale.".
